name: Ben Gurion Airport

runway.v: three runways; the longest, 08/26, is 4,062 m long and 45 m wide

hours.v: open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (with a night take-off curfew, see curfew)
hours.quote: The airport is open and provides services 24/7.

curfew.v: night take-off curfew: summer season (last Sunday of March to last Saturday of October) 01:40-05:00 local, winter season (last Sunday of October to last Saturday of March) 01:40-05:30 local; last slot that can be allocated before the curfew is 01:20; landing limitations every day 01:00-01:45 local; take-offs from 05:00 (summer) or 05:30 (winter) to 06:00 only within AIP noise limits
curfew.quote: Due to environmental noise issues, a takeoff curfew is in place. ... Summer season: from 01:40 to 05:00 ... Winter season: from 01:40 to 05:30 ... The final allocatable slot before the “night curfew” is 01:20. ... Landing limitations: every day between 01:00 – 01:45 local time.

slots.v: slots needed; private (GA/BA) flights request slots in GCR format from the IAA slot planning department (office Sunday-Thursday 08:00-16:00 local, closed on Jewish holidays; outside office hours via airport operations)
slots.quote: Request for slots for private flights (GA/BA) must be submitted in the GCR format

permits.v: private flights need an operational approval from the Civil Aviation Authority Supervision Division, a security approval from the Aviation Security Operations Center (by email), and an approved contract with a ground services provider at the airport
permits.quote: Operational approval from the Civil Aviation Authority Supervision Division ... security approval from the Aviation Security Operations Center via email ... Approval of contract with a ground services provider operating at the airport

handling.v: an operator must use one of the three ground service companies at the airport: AHS, LAU or QAS
handling.quote: An airline is obligated to liaise with one of the three ground services companies
